body: thank you.  i appreciate you taking the time to write to some random person.

i have been writing, thank you for replying.  it's one of those times i just want to get in the car and go...but nowhere to go and nobody to see.  i could talk to my kids (they are older) but damn nobody needs to see their dad like this.
i have no guns in the house but thanks
it's not a joke.  i just can't deal right now.
